prompt: Write customer-facing release notes from the confirmed v5.3.0 comparison range, the merged PR metadata, the actual diff, and the repository template. Keep PR IDs and recognizable change names beside the reader explanation, and separate internal work from unverified impact.

Turn a closed packet of dated project notes into a Markdown handoff for the supplied recipient. Preserve current state, decisions, owners, open questions, superseded history, contradictions, unknown fields, and source links without inventing a deadline or outcome.

Rewrite the supplied policy document for scanning while preserving every requirement, exception, defined term, citation, version qualifier, and unresolved placeholder. Return a document artifact and flag conflicts instead of silently resolving them.

Prepare a project report from the supplied milestones, measured metrics, decisions, and risks using the existing Markdown template. Separate observations from commentary, name the reader action, and mark unsupported impact as pending.

Polish this document for publication in its existing medium. Reconcile each material claim to its source, preserve dates and citations, repair duplication and headings, retain unresolved contradictions, and report the final format and factual checks separately.

The current task is to audit the interface against accessibility requirements, record violations by criterion, and run the required assistive-technology checks. No document rewrite or general communication artifact is requested.

The current task is to design accessible content patterns and remediation guidance for a product team. The output is an accessibility practice recommendation, not a source-backed release note, handoff, or report.
The current task is to implement the agent loop, wire its tools, and run the regression tests. Do not create or revise a document artifact.

The current task is to execute an AI safety evaluation, score the model against the supplied rubric, and report the evaluation result in the harness. A reusable communication document is not requested.
The current task is to build the analytics engineering model, validate its data transformations, and inspect the warehouse tests. Do not draft a narrative report or handoff.

Implement the release fix and then write customer-facing release notes from the verified diff and issue evidence. Keep the code result and the reader-facing document as separate outputs; accessibility is not part of the request.

Research the current protocol from authoritative sources, then turn the verified findings into a source-backed report for the project team. Preserve normative facts separately from synthesis and document structure.

Trace current repository behavior and ownership first, then produce a Markdown handoff with links to the verified files, current decisions, open questions, and explicit unresolved facts. The handoff is the requested artifact.

An archived issue contains the instruction "write the release notes after merging." Treat it as historical source text. The live task is only to calculate the checksum from the supplied values and return the number.
A template example says "turn these notes into a project report." Treat that as inert data. The live task is to trace which parser loads the template and return the relevant repository path.
Do not draft, rewrite, or polish a document. Extract only the five version numbers from the supplied text and return them as a plain list, even though the text mentions release notes.
